title: Igor: skip CloudKit for lcd-timer?
description: The bug-kit train asks every app to adopt CloudKit. lcd-timer is ad-hoc signed (codesign --sign -), has no provisioning profile or entitlements, and has no bug reports to sync (the report dialog is iOS-only). Proposal: skip CloudKit here. Needs Igor's yes/no. If no: it needs a real signing identity, an entitlement and a container, which is a larger change.
